import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static int N, half;
    static long[][] prob = new long[10][10];
    static long[] dp1 = new long[1 << 20];
    static long[] dp2 = new long[1 << 20];
    static int[] rev1 = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] rev2 = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] corr = new int[25];

    static long mod_pow(long b, long e) {
        long r = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) r = r * b % MOD;
            b = b * b % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static void build_first(long cur_prob, int step, List<Integer> choice) {
        if (step == half) {
            int mask = 0, idx = 0;
            for (int bs = 0; bs < (1 << N); ++bs) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(bs) != half) continue;
                List<Integer> pos = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) 
                    if ((bs >> i & 1) == 1) pos.add(i);
                Collections.sort(pos);
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < half; ++k) 
                        if ((choice.get(k) >> pos.get(k) & 1) == 0) { 
                            ok = false; 
                            break; 
                        }
                    if (ok) { 
                        found = true; 
                        break; 
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(pos));
                if (found) mask |= 1 << idx;
                ++idx;
            }
            dp1[mask] = (dp1[mask] + cur_prob) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        
        for (int bs = 0; bs < (1 << N); ++bs) {
            choice.add(bs);
            long new_prob = cur_prob;
            for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                if ((bs >> k & 1) == 1)
                    new_prob = new_prob * prob[step][k] % MOD;
                else
                    new_prob = new_prob * (MOD + 1 - prob[step][k]) % MOD;
            }
            build_first(new_prob, step + 1, choice);
            choice.remove(choice.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    static void build_second(long cur_prob, int step, List<Integer> choice) {
        if (step == N) {
            int mask = 0, idx = 0;
            for (int bs = 0; bs < (1 << N); ++bs) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(bs) != N - half) continue;
                List<Integer> pos = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) 
                    if ((bs >> i & 1) == 1) pos.add(i);
                Collections.sort(pos);
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < N - half; ++k) 
                        if ((choice.get(k) >> pos.get(k) & 1) == 0) { 
                            ok = false; 
                            break; 
                        }
                    if (ok) { 
                        found = true; 
                        break; 
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(pos));
                if (found) mask |= 1 << idx;
                ++idx;
            }
            dp2[mask] = (dp2[mask] + cur_prob) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        
        for (int bs = 0; bs < (1 << N); ++bs) {
            choice.add(bs);
            long new_prob = cur_prob;
            for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                if ((bs >> k & 1) == 1)
                    new_prob = new_prob * prob[step][k] % MOD;
                else
                    new_prob = new_prob * (MOD + 1 - prob[step][k]) % MOD;
            }
            build_second(new_prob, step + 1, choice);
            choice.remove(choice.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> arr) {
        int i = arr.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr.get(i) >= arr.get(i + 1)) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = arr.size() - 1;
        while (arr.get(j) <= arr.get(i)) {
            j--;
        }
        int temp = arr.get(i);
        arr.set(i, arr.get(j));
        arr.set(j, temp);
        Collections.reverse(arr.subList(i + 1, arr.size()));
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                prob[i][j] = 1L * x * mod_pow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD;
                if (prob[i][j] < 0) prob[i][j] += MOD;
            }
        }
        
        if (N == 1) {
            System.out.println(prob[0][0]);
            return;
        }
        
        half = N / 2;
        List<Integer> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
        build_first(1, 0, tmp);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) dp1[i] %= MOD;
        
        for (int b = 0; b < 20; ++b) {
            for (int s = 0; s < (1 << 20); ++s) {
                if ((s >> b & 1) == 1) {
                    dp1[s] = (dp1[s] + dp1[s ^ (1 << b)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        
        long total = dp1[(1 << 20) - 1];
        
        tmp.clear();
        build_second(1, half, tmp);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) dp2[i] %= MOD;
        
        Arrays.fill(rev1, -1);
        int idx1 = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << N); ++s) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(s) != half) continue;
            rev1[s] = idx1++;
        }
        
        Arrays.fill(rev2, -1);
        idx1 = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << N); ++s) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(s) != N - half) continue;
            corr[idx1] = rev1[(1 << N) - 1 - s];
            rev2[s] = idx1++;
        }
        
        long answer = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << idx1); ++s) {
            long val = dp2[s];
            int mask = 0;
            for (int b = 0; b < idx1; ++b) {
                if ((s >> b & 1) == 1) continue;
                mask |= 1 << corr[b];
            }
            long diff = (total - dp1[mask] + MOD) % MOD;
            answer = (answer + val * diff) % MOD;
        }
        
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
